title: Screening of GO-coated microporous polymeric filters for efficient paraquat removal: effect of support surface on membrane roughness and flux stability
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15802-15813
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00505E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Syed Sibt-e-Hassan, Nurmeen Adil, Yan Wang, Syed Ghulam Musharraf
We report the fabrication and systematic evaluation of three thin-layer graphene oxide (GO) composite membranes prepared by vacuum-filtering a GO dispersion onto low-cost microporous supports (i.e. mixed cellulose ester, nylon, and PVDF).
